facts.fact: WISeKey says in its 22 April 2024 release that SeyID, built on its WISeID platform, supports online KYC onboarding, one-time password authentication, QR-code login and digital signature of documents.
WISeKey says the SeyID app integrates an e-wallet storing the National ID and driver licence, generating a digital ID card with a QR code for third-party verification.
